summary: The agent implements a solid modeling pipeline with log-transformed targets, a multi-model ensemble, and proper out-of-fold target encoding. However, it suffers from significant data leakage by applying TF-IDF, SVD, frequency encoding, and group aggregations on the combined train and test sets prior to splitting. Furthermore, it ignores the temporal nature of the drug pricing data by using a randomized K-Fold split, which introduces look-ahead bias.
